Self-Drive & 4x4 Hire

Explore Zanzibar at your own pace with a rental car or 4x4 vehicle, with flexible pickup and drop-off options.

Why Self-Drive in Zanzibar

Freedom to Explore

Renting a car gives you the flexibility to discover Zanzibar's diverse attractions on your own schedule. From Stone Town's historic streets to remote beaches in the south, a self-drive trip puts you in control of your adventure.

Flexibility

Create your own itinerary, stop at viewpoints that catch your eye, and linger as long as you like at each location. No fixed tour schedules or group constraints.

Access to Remote Areas

Reach secluded beaches, hidden coves, and villages that are difficult to access by public transport. The east and south coasts are particularly rewarding with a rental vehicle.

Cost-Effective for Groups

For families or small groups, self-drive can be more economical than multiple tour bookings, especially for a 3-7 day stay.

Vehicle Options

Available Rental Categories

Compact Cars

Suitable for city driving and well-maintained roads around Stone Town and north coast. Good fuel economy and easy parking. Examples: Toyota Prius, Vios, or similar.

SUVs & Crossovers

Higher ground clearance for varied road conditions. Comfortable for small groups with luggage space. Examples: Toyota RAV4, Honda CR-V, or similar.

4x4 Pickup & Expedition Vehicles

Essential for south and east coast exploration, especially during rainy season when some roads may be challenging. Includes roof rack for gear. Examples: Toyota Land Cruiser, Nissan Patrol, or similar.

Important Information

Rental Guidelines

Driving License

Valid international driving permit recommended. Must have license held for at least 1 year. Stone Town driving is on the left.

Insurance

Basic insurance included. Comprehensive coverage available at additional cost. Check what's covered regarding off-road driving and gravel roads.

Fuel Policy

Rentals provided with full tank, return with full tank. Fuel stations are available in Stone Town, but sparse on south and east coasts — plan accordingly.

Age Requirements

Minimum age 23, maximum 70. Young driver surcharge may apply for drivers under 25. Some categories may have upper age limits.
